title: Institutional Readiness Assessment
formats: docx; xlsx; csv; json; md; mmd; svg; png
purpose: Assess strategic, data, infrastructure, workflow, workforce, quality, economic, governance, procurement, and continuing support readiness.
primary_audience: Institutional decision-makers and multidisciplinary project teams
required_inputs: Defined decision problem, realistic comparator, local evidence, named owners, and applicable institutional requirements
expected_output: Versioned institutional decision record with conditions, monitoring, review date, and exit route
prerequisites: Book Chapter 2; governed working copy; accountable owner
use_frequency: At initiation and each material review
essential_or_optional: Essential when relevant to the decision
recommended_format: DOCX for narrative work; XLSX for registers and calculations
